canonical_name_en: Fried tofu and rice vermicelli with shrimp paste
description_vi: Món bún ăn cùng đậu rán, mắm tôm, rau sống; thường có thêm thịt heo/chả cốm.
description_en: Rice vermicelli with fried tofu, shrimp paste sauce, herbs, often with pork items.
common_ingredients: bún,đậu phụ chiên,mắm tôm,rau sống,thịt heo,chả cốm
dietary_notes: Not halal by default due to shrimp paste and often pork; risky for shellfish allergy.

description_vi: Phở nước dùng bò, bánh phở, rau thơm.
description_en: Beef noodle soup with rice noodles, beef broth, herbs.
common_ingredients: bánh phở,nước dùng bò,thịt bò,hành,rau thơm
possible_hidden_ingredients: nước mắm,bột ngọt,gia vị công nghiệp
dietary_notes: Contains beef; ask about fish sauce, gluten additives, and broth ingredients.

description_vi: Bún ăn với chả thịt heo nướng, nước chấm, rau sống.
description_en: Rice noodles with grilled pork patties/slices, dipping sauce, herbs.
common_ingredients: bún,thịt heo,nước mắm,rau sống,đu đủ/cà rốt ngâm
dietary_notes: Contains pork; not halal by default; possible fish sauce and hidden gluten in seasonings.

description_vi: Bánh mì kẹp pate/thịt/trứng/rau/sốt tùy quán.
description_en: Vietnamese baguette sandwich with various fillings and sauces.
dietary_notes: Contains wheat/gluten; often contains pork pate/meat; egg/milk/soy possible.

description_vi: Cà phê với lớp kem trứng và sữa đặc.
description_en: Coffee topped with whipped egg and condensed milk.
dietary_notes: Contains egg and milk; not suitable for egg/milk allergy or vegan diet.
